description: GCMZDrops2 (ごちゃまぜドロップス2) for AviUtl ExEdit2

script: if ($item -and ($item.Attributes -band [System.IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)) { try { [System.IO.Directory]::Delete($link); $item = $null } catch { Write-Warning "Failed to remove stale junction ${link}: $_" } }

if ($item) { Write-Warning "$link exists and is not a junction; leaving it untouched. GCMZDrops was not linked." } else { New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path $link -Value "$dir\Plugin\GCMZDrops" | Out-Null }

if ($item) { if ($item.Attributes -band [System.IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) { try { [System.IO.Directory]::Delete($link) } catch { Write-Warning "Failed to remove junction ${link}: $_" } } else { Write-Warning "$link is not a junction; not removed." } }

notes: If an older GCMZDrops was installed by other means, remove it manually first (see upstream release notes). Requires AviUtl ExEdit2 2.0beta30a or later; scoop installs it if missing but does not update an old one.
